_doc: Scoped corridors view for line Bite-2 economics cascade

_fare_record.source: Penghu NSA / 公車處 official one-way fares: Magong->Qimei NT$437/person, Magong->Wang'an NT$272/person (public 交通船). Private fast 快艇 / island-hop day tours run NT$709-900 incl scooter (ezpenghu, EIT, goplay). Premium per-seat fast-boat transfer on the 18nm Magong->Qimei leg ~NT$485 (~$15).
_fare_record.method: R1: anchored to Magong->Qimei (18nm, matches distance) official public fare NT$437 ($13.5) lifted to private fast-boat premium ~NT$485 ($15). Budget=public交通船 $13.5; tour packages $22-28 RT bundle scooter (not pure transfer). NT$485/32.3=$15.0.

_demand_record.pool_basis: gross south-sea island-hop pool (terminal-area throughput, incl. Tongpan/Hujing short-hops and visitor-center foot traffic)
_demand_record.source: Penghu County Govt / Tourism Administration scenic-stats monthly bulletin (DGBAS form 20702-01-01, Dec-2025 cumulative): South Sea Visitor Center & surrounds (南海遊客中心及周邊地區 - the Magong departure terminal for all Qimei/Wang'an/Tongpan/Hujing tourist boats) 176,528 visitors in 2025. Cross-refs same table: Wang'an scenic area 20,054, Qimei scenic area 10,808 (on-island spot counters, likely under-count). Historic: South Sea VC ~393k/yr in 2014 (county bulletin 104-04) - pool roughly halved over a decade.
_demand_record.method: Terminal-throughput proxy: every Qimei/Wang'an boat passenger boards at the South Sea Visitor Center, so its annual count upper-bounds one-way departures on the south-sea routes; includes short-hop Tongpan/Hujing riders and some non-boarding foot traffic ('及周邊地區') -> tagged gross, med-low. Highly seasonal (Apr-Sep carries the bulk; winter near-zero). Down-weighted per R3 variant: counted pool is the multi-island south-sea network, of which the 23nm Qimei leg is the longest segment.

_fare_record.source: Liuqiu Township Office / Pingtung County official tariff: public ferry (公營交通船) NT$200 one-way / NT$380 RT; private operators (民營 - Dongliu Line alliance: Taifu 泰富, Lanbai 藍白, Dafu joint fleet) NT$250 one-way / NT$450 RT, 25-30min (pthg.gov.tw, kkday, ferry.tw, ianchen.life - all agree). No scheduled premium/luxury per-seat tier above the NT$250 private ferry on Donggang-Liuqiu. NOTE: a boutique per-seat speedboat DOES operate from Houbihu (Kenting) to Xiaoliuqiu at NT$300-380/seat, min 2 pax, hourly (Klook) - different origin, signals nascent premium per-seat demand in the Liuqiu market.
_fare_record.method: R1 ladder: public NT$200 ($6.2) / private NT$250 ($7.7) one-way - private tier is the top scheduled per-seat product; no premium class above it (R5-EXT cascade stands). NT$250/32.3=$7.74.

_demand_record.source: Tourism Administration (觀光署) scenic stats: Xiaoliuqiu visitors 441k (2019) -> 1,118,000 (2023) per Rwnews/菱傳媒; annual visitors 'break 1 million' yearly (TWReporter, ethesys). Pingtung Liuqiu township publishes official 客船旅客統計 (ferry passenger stats, round-trip 人次).
_demand_record.method: R3-EXCEPTION + R3-GOLD: Xiaoliuqiu is a boat-only island (NO airport/bridge) -> visitor arrivals EQUAL crossing ridership; do not down-weight. Used 2023 official visitor figure 1.118M as one-way pax pool; ferry boardings ~2.2M round-trip. Highest-confidence demand grounding in the Taiwan set.

corridors._premium_cascade_reason: Top scheduled tier is the standard private ferry (NT$250/$7.7, official county tariff); no premium per-seat class above it on Donggang-Liuqiu. R5-EXT. (Premium per-seat speedboat exists only from Kenting/Houbihu - different origin.)

_fare_record.anchor_type: resort_scheduled_speedboat_per_seat (R1-RESORT: Santhiya Koh Phangan published per-seat speedboat transfer to/from Koh Samui)
_fare_record.notes: Premium per-seat anchor THB 1,150/pp one-way = USD 35.0 (Santhiya Resort official scheduled speedboat Koh Phangan<->Koh Samui; private speedboat max 12 pax THB 10,000/boat/way on same page). Corroborating premium per-seat points: WowSamui Haad Rin speedboat transfer w/ hotel pickup THB 1,500/pp; Tripadvisor Full-Moon speedboat transfers from USD 34.53/adult. Fare ladder (THB/pp one-way): budget Songserm/Raja ~250-300; standard fast-cat Lomprayah/Seatran 300-400 (ferrysamui.com class 400, promo 250-275; siamtickets Lomprayah speedboat 350, Echo 500); PREMIUM per-seat speedboat 1,150-1,500 <- anchor 1,150; charter 8,500-10,000/boat (~10-12 pax, kohsanuk/Reddit). FX 32.85.

_demand_record.source: Koh Phangan receives ~1M visitors/yr, ~75% (~825,000) for the Full Moon Party (ThaiJo peer-reviewed research article citing official figures, 2024-era; kohphangancity.go.th municipal plan ~2,000 visitors/day baseline). Trio cross-check: >1M tourists entered Tao-Phangan-Samui in Q1-2024 alone (MGR Online / TAT + Koh Tao Tourism Business Association). Full Moon Party draws 20,000-40,000/event (adventureinyou/41n8, 2025). Phangan has NO airport - boat-only island (R3-EXCEPTION: arrivals = crossing ridership).
_demand_record.method: ~1M island visitors x 2 one-way crossings = ~2M one-way island boat legs/yr across ALL access routes (Samui fast-cats + Donsak/Surat direct ferries + Chumphon-side southbound). Via-Samui share modeled at ~50% (Lomprayah Pralarn + Seatran Bangrak + Haad Rin Queen + FMP speedboats dominate published schedules) -> ~1.0M one-way on the Samui<->Phangan crossing. Boat-only island so no air leakage; share-split is the modeled step, hence med-low.
